page.overview:
Who is Gajii?

Gajii was a friend and comrade of Wakkanai who held the right to Republic City's water treatment facility. As a member of the Utilities Commission, Gajii never accepted graft or bribery.

As a friend of Wakkanai, she was not seen as objective when it began to be debated if Wakkanai should keep the rights to the facility after there were reports of dangerous incidents. While she did not recuse herself and was not challenged to do so, she knew it was only a matter of time before San Ho tried to win the issue by forcing her recusal, so she pushed hard for the vote to happen sooner rather than later.

Gajii was a patriotic bureaucrat, and wanted to see Republic City's resources and needs kept in good hands.
